items.title: Actual centered selfadjoint operator and positive squared defect

items.statement: E is a finite-dimensional real Hilbert Borel space with canonical volume; rank zero is an explicit extension of the source Euclidean convention. V:E→ℝ is C²; 0<α≤β; α‖v‖²≤D²V(x)[v,v]≤β‖v‖² for every x,v; η>0 and βη≤1. μ=volume.tilted(−V), J=Law(X,X+√ηZ) for independent X∼μ and Z∼N(0,I), and ν=J.snd. Finite dimensionality of E does not imply finite dimensionality of L²(ν). Let Λ be the law of (Y,2X−Y) under J, F(x,y)=(x,2x−y), and P the L²(J) conditional-expectation orthogonal projection onto the second-coordinate sigma algebra. The laws μ,J,ν are probabilities. There exist a Markov kernel S with, for every y, S(y)=volume.tilted(x↦−V((y+x)/2)−‖y−x‖²/(8η)), Λ disintegrated by S and both marginals equal to ν; an involutive selfadjoint linear isometry U with Ug=g∘F J-a.e.; an isometric pullback M with Mu=u∘snd J-a.e.; and a selfadjoint T on L²(ν) such that for every u, PMu=Mu, MTu=PUPMu, ‖Tu‖≤‖u‖, Tu(y)=∫u(x)S(y,dx) ν-a.e. and ∫Tu dν=∫u dν. There is a constant class q=1 ν-a.e. with Tq=q and ⟨q,u⟩=∫u dν for all u. Its exact closed orthogonal kernel H₀ is all of L²₀(ν). The full defect D=I−T² is positive, Dq=0 and ⟨Du,u⟩=‖u‖²−‖Tu‖² for all u. The actual restriction T₀:H₀→H₀ agrees with T on every u∈H₀, is selfadjoint and contractive. D₀=I_H₀−T₀² is positive, agrees with D as an ambient L² class on H₀, and satisfies ⟨D₀u,u⟩=‖u‖²−‖T₀u‖² for all u∈H₀.
assumptions: The complete potential, curvature, initialization law and step conditions are stated above. No operator, probability, stationarity, mean-zero preservation or coercivity certificate is supplied by the caller.
L² consists of AE classes; finite dimension of E does not make L² finite dimensional. The whole closed mean-zero subspace is used.
Zero-dimensional E is explicitly included as an extension of the source Euclidean convention; αη=1 is retained.
